topic.title: DITA References View Add-on
topic.shortdesc: The DITA References View add-on adds a side view that shows outgoing and incoming references for the current DITA topic.

body.note:
This add-on is compatible with the following products:
Oxygen XML Editor
Oxygen XML Author
Oxygen XML Developer
body.p: This add-on contributes a DITA References side view that shows all outgoing and incoming references for the current DITA topic. Once the add-on is installed, the view is available in both Text and Author modes.
